verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe custom rules for team-specific issues, uploaded style guides, and repo-specific standards set in greptile.json, which overrides dashboard settings and supports custom context. Rules can be scoped per directory, and it imports or indexes existing rule files like CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and cursor.rules, which covers natural-language rules and linked style guides. Missing for 10: any evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, depth on rule syntax and enforcement behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are reliably enforced.
